# Giriraaj Textiles

## Overview
Giriraaj Textiles is a yarn manufacturer in Beawar, Rajasthan (Ajmer region), established in 2025. Proprietorship led by S Agarwal. Up to 10 employees. GST registered. Consistent monthly production. Stock dispatches from Beawar.

Primary customers include distributors and export agents sourcing yarn for industrial bag closing. Domestic buyers are also served.

## Products
- Polyester yarn: 3-ply, counts 10, 12, and 15. Recycled and virgin. MOQ 1,000 cones. Colours include white, cream, blue, and more on request.
- Polypropylene yarn: PP yarn for woven sack bag closing. Specifications shared on enquiry.

## Typical use
Closing and stitching HDPE bags and other industrial bags on bag-closing machines such as Revo.

## Capabilities
- HSN 5509 (polyester yarn)
- MOQ 1,000 cones
- Consistent monthly production
- Export packing on request
- Enquiry replies within 12 hours

## Lead handling
Enquiry via WhatsApp or phone. Replies within 12 hours.

## HSN
- 5509: Yarn of synthetic staple fibres (other than sewing thread), not put up for retail sale
- 3923: Plastic articles for the conveyance or packing of goods
